description: backlog ask mints an item in state=asked with options/a recommendation, backlog answer records the answer once (and is idempotent on a second call), and backlog show reads the whole thing back. --role is recorded here with an OLD pre-rename dispatch role name (fixer): the frozen Python oracle treats this field as free text (backlog.py validates only the identifier charset, activity._IDENTIFIER_RE, never a closed RoleId enum), but Rust's write surfaces accept only current role names, backlog's --role included, so conformance's replay-time translation (role_translate.translate_role_argv) rewrites it to the current name (builder) before this reaches Rust. A backlog card that was written under the old name before the rename still reads back verbatim — see the history-* scenarios — only new writes require the current name.
